provenance: Self-authored PPL executed on isolated original virtual HP Prime G1 revision15751. Only accepted completed controls are curated here; rejected syntax/loader/UI-context probes remain private. Actual matrix Textbook rendering and color behavior were inspected in original framebuffers; no proprietary image or font bytes are distributed.

rendering.scalar_result: All measured ordinary numeric1/3 and retained formula1/3 results stay decimal0.333333333333 in each Textbook mode.
rendering.auto: Follows worksheet default: initiallyNo; switching sheetdefaultYes affects inherited cells while explicitNo remains algebraic.
rendering.argb: Highbytes belowFF preserve rawvalues and affect compositing. Repeated redraws can accumulate; do not infer a single-blend formula or fixed finalpixel from a settled frame. FFhighbyte samples canonicalize toinherit. Raw0x01000000 is legitimate black, notAuto.
rendering.sizing: Requested row50 and column100 produced51/101pixel gridsteps in measured frames.
